verdict.rationale: Poly has a native tag system: Poly tags, with colors, sync bidirectionally with macOS Finder tags. This gives some basic tag-based organization. There is no evidence of typed properties or metadata fields on notes, and none showing tags can filter or narrow search. Missing for 10: typed property/metadata fields on notes, tag-based search/filter/retrieval, schema consistency or enforcement across notes, tagging within Mind notes/journal entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
